outcome: Infant immune responses (cytokine levels of IL-6, IL-10, IL-13, TNF-a, and IFN-g, and lymphocyte proliferation) in cord blood
cohort: The cohort consisted of 463 women recruited in early pregnancy into the Project Viva longitudinal cohort whose infants had cord blood assayed after delivery.
finding: Maternal depression is associated with lower levels of IL-10 in infant cord blood after stimulation with cockroach or dust mite allergen.
